questions.question: Who directed Iron Man (2008), the film that launched the MCU?
questions.note: Favreau also plays Happy Hogan. Black directed Iron Man 3.

questions.question: What 2009 James Cameron film was the first to gross over $2 billion worldwide?
questions.note: Set on Pandora among the Na’vi; sequels followed in the 2020s.

questions.question: Who played Mark Zuckerberg in The Social Network (2010)?
questions.note: Garfield is Eduardo Saverin; Timberlake is Sean Parker. Aaron Sorkin wrote the script.

questions.question: In Interstellar, what is the name of the boxy robot that accompanies Cooper?
questions.note: CASE is the other folding robot on the mission; GERTY is the robot in Moon (2009).

questions.question: In Get Out, what does Missy Armitage call the hypnotic state she drops Chris into?
questions.note: Triggered with the clink of a teacup. Catherine Keener plays Missy.

questions.question: In which Marvel film does Thanos first snap his fingers and wipe out half of all life?
Who directed Joker (2019), the Joaquin Phoenix film that won him Best Actor?
questions.note: Phillips is best known for The Hangover. Scorsese’s King of Comedy is a clear influence.

questions.question: In Top Gun: Maverick, what is the call sign of Miles Teller’s character?
questions.note: He’s Goose’s son. Hangman is Glen Powell; Phoenix is Monica Barbaro.

questions.question: Which song did Ryan Gosling perform from Barbie at the 2024 Oscars?
questions.note: Billie Eilish’s “What Was I Made For?” won Best Original Song; Gosling still stole the night.

questions.question: Who played the title physicist in Christopher Nolan’s Oppenheimer (2023)?
questions.note: Murphy won Best Actor; RDJ won Supporting Actor as Lewis Strauss.
